A few quick things about how we handle quality at Heirloom so you know what to expect:

All of our roses are premium own-root plants grown at our nurseries in Oregon, not bought from third parties.
They are shipped in 1-gallon containers with soil, well-hydrated, defoliated (leaves removed) on purpose so they travel safely.
Every rose is covered by a one-year guarantee, and our garden advisors review any concerns one-on-one.
Perennials are also nursery-grown and shipped in 1-gallon pots, with a 90-day guarantee.
